newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 97 CPI target of below 3pct realistic -BOI.
newsitem.headline: Italy 97 CPI target of below 3pct realistic -BOI.

text.p: Inflation running at under three percent next year was a "realistic target but should not be taken for granted", the Bank of Italy said in its regular half-yearly report on Thursday.
Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said earlier on Thursday he expected inflation to hold below three percent in the last quarter of 1996.
"The objective remains that of an average which is clearly lower than (three percent) in 1997, in line with other major industrialised countries," he said in a speech.
